components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #0061bb; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #004f9a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0061bb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subdued action button for cancel, secondary filters, and resets.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f3f4f6; color: #111827; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #e5e7eb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0061bb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line input field for search, column renaming, and parameter values.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #111827; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 6px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0061bb; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }

components.name: Header Navigation Tab
components.description: Main workflow navigation tab with bottom accent bar.

narrative.overview:
Quantis is a disciplined, scholarly workstation designed for undergraduate students, graduate researchers, and university faculty. It brings the functional precision, variable metadata rigors, and dense data inspection familiar from legacy econometric tools (SPSS, Stata) into a clean, modern web interface. The interface prioritizes scannable empirical data, zero-friction calculation, and transparent scientific reporting over gratuitous decoration.

Aesthetic philosophy centers on Scholarly Precision and Clean Restraint. Every element earns its place through utility: data grids display high-density numerical information without clipping, statistical test outputs follow clear tabular hierarchies with APA standards, and interactive affordances remain calm and tactile. Visual bloat, marketing gradients, and generic SaaS card patterns are deliberately excluded.

The design system harmonizes seamlessly with the National Economics University (NEU) AI Portal design standards, supporting both standalone academic workstations and embedded iframe environments with automatic light and dark mode synchronization.
keyCharacteristics: High-density data grid tables with sticky numerical indices and monospace alignments.
Authoritative institutional cobalt accent paired with neutral slate-gray surfaces.
Clear semantic markers for missing data and invalid numerical inputs that educate without obstructing.
Strict 6px control and 8px container corner rhythm aligned with the NEU AI Portal design language.
Flat structural layout with purposeful, state-driven elevations.

rules.name: The 10% Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Academic Cobalt is reserved for primary focal actions, active selections, and state highlights. It should cover no more than 10% of any analytical screen to prevent visual fatigue during prolonged research sessions.

rules.name: The Semantic Reserve Rule
rules.body: Rose, Amber, and Crimson are strictly reserved for data validity states and system alerts. They are never used for decorative accents or unrelated categorizations.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All statistical results, p-values, regression coefficients, and matrix cells must render with tabular figures or within monospace contexts so decimal points and digit positions align vertically.

rules.name: The Scientific Case Rule
rules.body: Variable names, statistical metrics (e.g., R², F, t, p), and formula expressions retain exact scientific capitalization; never apply CSS uppercase transformations to statistical symbols.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: Primary data grids, cards, and toolbars are flat at rest. Drop shadows must never be added to standard content cards or table cells; depth is conveyed purely via 1px border contrast and tonal step-downs.

dos: Do maintain a strict 6px radius (rounded-md) for controls and 8px (rounded-lg) for modal containers.
Do format all statistical output with monospace tabular numerals and scientific notation where precision demands it.
Do reserve Academic Cobalt (#0061bb) for intentional primary focal points, selections, and active states.
Do highlight missing values with soft rose (#fff1f2) and invalid numeric cells with soft amber (#fffbeb).
Do ensure all interactive elements have visible keyboard focus rings (outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand); outline-offset: 2px).
donts: Don't add decorative dropshadows, blurred gradient orbs, or floating glows to standard content cards.
Don't apply uppercase text transformation to variable names or statistical indicators (p, t, F, R²).
Don't round numeric values prematurely in the grid; preserve raw user input precision in data storage.
Don't use saturated red or green accents for standard neutral data states.
Don't introduce non-standard corner radiuses (e.g. 16px, 24px pill buttons) that break the NEU AI Portal alignment.
